verdict.rationale: Navan is a SaaS travel and expense platform with mobile apps and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out, privacy setting, or data-collection control. The material covers MCP setup, APIs, rewards, and Navan Edge personalization from booking history, none of which is an opt-out mechanism.
